data.one_liner: Calculate simple, weighted, and exponential moving averages for lists of numbers or objects.
data.what_it_does: Provides a MovingAverage class to compute simple, weighted, and exponential moving averages over collections of data. Supports customizable window sizes, partial starts, and getter functions for custom objects.
use_when: You need to compute simple moving averages for time-series or numerical list data.
You require weighted or exponential moving averages for statistical or data smoothing purposes.
avoid_when: You need complex charting or visualization UI widgets to display the moving average data.
You are handling real-time streaming data that requires reactive stream-based operators.
strengths: Supports multiple moving average types (simple, weighted, exponential).
Works with lists of numbers or custom objects via mapping functions.
weaknesses: Not built as a reactive stream-based operator.
Lacks built-in UI components or chart plotting capabilities.
